RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your qualifications are substantial, but the announcement may omit relevant experience, and a leadership role may prioritize management, regulatory expertise, and interview performance over academic credentials.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and feedback on how your experience compared with the requirements.

Raise concerns about discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria, or unequal treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition. If you are considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines now; waiting for feedback may not pause them.
